clips.title: The story
paras: The Valley of Bones is a desolate canyon along the crags of Shen'dralas, choked with dust, ancient remains, and restless undead. Haunted by the lingering spirits of the Magram centaur clan and patrolled by dark necromancers, it is dominated by the colossal rib cages of mysterious ancient beasts known as the Dead Goliaths.

Tucked away in the southern reaches of the region, the Valley of Bones lives up to its grim name. Skeletal horrors walk the dusty ravines, raised and bound by centaur necromancers who draw upon dark sorceries. The spirits of deceased Magram centaur wander the wastes alongside them, bound to this barren earth long after their violent deaths. Adding to the canyon's ominous nature are the Dead Goliaths—two immense skeletons slumped against the rocky cliffs whose true origin remains a total mystery to scholars and wanderers alike.
